This guide will show you how to establish a fully functional crypto store using Cloudflare Pages, ensuring you are not dependent on traditional payment systems. By leveraging the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can regain control over your digital commerce operations and serve your audience effectively.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 02 provides a robust framework for digital creators who face restrictions. Traditional platforms often fail due to regulatory issues or operational limitations in various regions. By using Cloudflare Pages combined with Workers and Supabase, you establish an independent digital storefront where you own the infrastructure. This setup not only enhances reliability but also empowers you with complete data sovereignty, eliminating the risks associated with third-party dependencies.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you need a few essential components. First, create a Cloudflare account and set up your Pages project. Second, gather your digital products and prepare them for upload. Ensure you have a NOWPayments account ready for crypto payment processing. Familiarity with basic HTML and JavaScript will streamline the setup, allowing you to customize your store's appearance and functionality effectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once your store is set up, the next step is configuring your payment and delivery pipeline. Integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare setup to enable seamless crypto transactions. This involves creating API keys and setting up webhooks for payment confirmation. Additionally, use Supabase for order management, ensuring that customer data is securely stored and easily accessible. This configuration allows you to process transactions and deliver products instantly, maintaining a smooth customer experience.
Complete ownership of your digital commerce infrastructure means no more platform dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your store configured, it's time to go live. Conduct thorough testing to ensure that your payment process works flawlessly on the mainnet. Once confirmed, launch your store and promote it through your channels. Monitor the transaction process as your first customer makes a purchase, ensuring everything from payment confirmation to product delivery operates as intended. This hands-on approach solidifies your understanding of the infrastructure and builds confidence in your setup.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After launching your store, consider strategies for scaling. Start by analyzing customer feedback and sales data to identify areas for improvement. Optimize your product offerings based on trends and customer preferences. You can expand your infrastructure by adding more products or leveraging the Edge Commerce Stack for more complex needs. This proactive approach not only enhances customer satisfaction but also ensures your business grows sustainably.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my Cloudflare Pages store?

Integrating NOWPayments involves creating an account and obtaining API keys. Add these keys to your Cloudflare Workers script to handle payment processing. Ensure you set up webhooks for transaction confirmations to automate your fulfillment process.
What are the main advantages of using Stack 02 over Stack 01?

Stack 02 offers a more comprehensive solution with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, providing enhanced performance and scalability. It includes end-to-end testing before handoff, ensuring your store is ready for high traffic and complex transactions.
Can I use GitHub Pages for hosting my digital store?

Yes, GitHub Pages can host your digital store. However, using Cloudflare Pages with Stack 02 provides superior performance and additional features like serverless functions, which are beneficial for scaling your store.
What types of products can I sell through this setup?

You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, software, and templates. The infrastructure supports instant delivery and automatic payment processing, making it ideal for digital creators.
How long does it take to deploy my store using Stack 02?
Deploying Stack 02 typically takes 48 hours. COREMERCH handles the deployment process and ensures everything is end-to-end tested before handing off the completed store to you.
